categories.main_business_segments: Liaoning Kelong Fine Chemical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the fine chemical industry, focusing on the production and sales of construction additives, chemical products, and surfactants. Key product lines include polycarboxylate superplasticizers, epoxy ether derivatives, glycol ether series, acrylic hydroxy esters, and surface-active agents. The company also engages in downstream activities such as concrete processing and building materials through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary synthesis and production technologies for polycarboxylate high-performance water reducers, epoxy ether derivatives, and acrylic hydroxy esters. It employs advanced methods such as high-speed spray drying for powder products and catalytic synthesis for acrylic esters. The firm has independent intellectual property rights for key technologies including VPEG new polyether monomers and UV-curable polyethers, and it continuously invests in R&D for new materials like graphene zinc powder coatings and nano-oxide catalysts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include construction companies, infrastructure projects, and manufacturers in the chemical, pharmaceutical, coatings, and electronics industries. Major end markets are concrete admixtures for high-speed railways, highways, bridges, nuclear power plants, and other large infrastructure projects. The company also serves international clients in Europe and Southeast Asia, including major cosmetic brands like L'Oréal and Unilever.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant sales in Northeast, Southwest, North China, East China, South China, Central China, and Northwest regions. It has production facilities in Liaoyang, Panjin, Chengdu, and subsidiaries in Beijing, Shenyang, and Yantai. Export markets include the United States, Russia, India, Mongolia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Philippines, Turkey, and Chile.
categories.supply_chain_position: Liaoning Kelong operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the chemical supply chain, producing fine chemical intermediates and finished products such as polycarboxylate superplasticizers and epoxy ether derivatives. It also extends downstream into concrete processing and building materials manufacturing through subsidiaries, integrating vertically within the construction materials industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation and R&D as core competitive advantages, focusing on product series development, synthesis process optimization, and application technology. It maintains strategic alliances with research institutes and universities, invests in new product development like UV-curable polyethers, graphene coatings, and nano-oxide catalysts, and aims to expand international market presence. The firm also pursues investment and acquisitions in emerging fields such as new materials and clean energy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical products including construction additives, epoxy ether derivatives, and fine chemicals. The company also earns income from downstream product sales like ready-mixed concrete and building materials. Additional revenue streams include investment income and government subsidies related to technology development projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic producer in the fine chemical and construction additive sectors, with a strong brand and technological edge. It competes with numerous domestic manufacturers in a market with sufficient supply capacity. Its products have gained certifications and recognition, and it actively expands into international markets to enhance competitiveness against global peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 632 million, a 13.19% increase from the previous year, though it continued to incur net losses attributable to shareholders. Total assets were about RMB 1.05 billion with net assets around RMB 448 million. The company’s cash flow from operations improved significantly, and it maintains ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D. Despite losses, it shows signs of operational cash flow improvement and strategic growth initiatives.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Liaoning Kelong emphasizes high-performance, environmentally friendly chemical products with proprietary technologies that enhance product efficacy and application versatility. Its polycarboxylate superplasticizers offer high water reduction rates and excellent cement adaptability, supporting advanced construction needs. The company’s integrated technical service system and extensive application database provide tailored solutions, differentiating it through innovation, quality, and customer support.
